meta.title: VIETNAM VLOG | 7 days in Ninh Binh & Hoi An
meta.description:
Ninh Binh deserves more than just a day trip. Join me in spending 4 days there, then we take a flight and head down to the ancient town of Hoi An
Watch in 4k :)

Watch Vietnam part 1 here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rZ2b6JsjOSs&t=489s

Travel date: 26 September 2024

Music from
- Artlist: Get 2 months free https://artlist.io/referral/b38638ac-06f1-4c2c-9e82-49407f4a37fc
- Epidemic Sounds: Free trial https://share.epidemicsound.com/3c6yfc
*above are affliate links, if you choose to purchase through them, I may earn a small commission at no extra cost to you

Day 1 NINH BINH
(00:39) Arrival into Ninh Binh
(01:39) Ninh Binh Old Town (Pho co Hoa Lu)

Day 2 NINH BINH
(03:47) Trang An Boat Tour
(06:48) Ha Lan Homestay & Restaurant for lunch
(07:20) Golden hour at Sunset Point

Day 3 NINH BINH
(08:06) Hang Mua for sunrise
(10:48) Hoa Lu Ancient Capital

Day 4 NINH BINH
(12:20) Tam Coc
(13:36) Coffee Lan for drinks
(14:18) Bich Dong Pagoda

Day 5 HOI AN
(15:26) Check in Qualia De Hotel Hoi An
(16:09) Mrs Tam for dinner

Day 6 HOI AN
(17:50) Bike ride from Hoi An to An Bang beach
(19:20) Breakfast at hotel
(19:45) Hoi An ancient town
(21:45) Oche Boutique for custom clothes
(22:33) Reaching Out Teahouse
(24:11) Broken rice for dinner
(24:58) Hoi An boat tour (sunset time)

Day 7 HOI AN
(27:35) Coconut Boat Tour
(30:12) Precious Heritage Art Gallery Museum
(31:16) Banh Mi Sum for lunch
(31:46) Custom dress check
(32:19) Chicken rice for dinner
(32:52) Final fit of custom dress

#chillvlog #vietnamtravel #silentvlog

comments.text: I’m Vietnamese, and I’m so happy you chose Ninh Binh and Hoi An for your trip. They have such different vibes—Ninh Binh feels peaceful and surrounded by nature, while Hoi An is warm, colorful, and full of charm. I hope your 7 days in Vietnam gave you lots of beautiful memories. ❤🇻🇳

comments.author: @EnglishPrinceton
comments.text: Ninh Binh and Hoi An are such a good combination for a Vietnam trip. I was actually looking into Vietnam dental tourism too and was surprised by how affordable good-quality dental care can be compared with back home. I found Dentaltrip useful for checking clinics in different areas, so you can fit treatment into the trip without missing out on places like these.

comments.author: @leonboois5414
comments.text: I spent three nights in Hoi An in mid-April, 2024 and thoroughly enjoyed them!  I stayed a modest but nice and clean B&B in the Old Town.  I walked many of the streets and narrow lanes featured in your video and was enthralled by the old French architecture.  It is a pity that many of the old colonial houses have been turned into shops and not used for their primary purpose.  I also visited the art and photography gallery (which was close to my B&B) twice and bought VIETNAM, Mosaic of Contrasts II the day before my departure.

First of all you did god job.
I have been in vietnam about 5 days ago and stayed there for 20 days.I would never make a holiday there again. first of all people don’t respect you as a pedestrian you can’t walk on the streets. There was a travel agent agency all of my own. Don’t trust the photos you see in the booking calm or whatever it was bad. The people are only interested on your money. They don’t respect you. They don’t have any right on you.
